biography.value:
妖精龍Faerie Dragon

    妖精龍長着貓咪的體型和蝴蝶的翅膀。它習慣露出尖銳的牙齒咧嘴而笑，並抽動尾巴來表達內心喜悅，這種嬉鬧之態唯有戰鬥時纔會收斂。

    隱形搗蛋鬼Invisible Tricksters。妖精龍出現時唯一讓人覺得警覺的便是那一陣令人窒息的嬉笑。它們會隱形於視線之外，然後觀賞受害者如何在其惡作劇下奮力掙扎。樂夠了之後，它們會視“獵物”的性格和態度而決定是否現出身形。

    活潑而友善Friendly and Bright。妖精龍思維敏捷，鍾愛財寶和好夥伴，還有着惡作劇般的幽默感。旅行者可以藉由它對“財寶”執着的龍類本性，以糖果、烘焙食品和各種小玩意兒來換得妖精龍的情報，或藉此安全通過妖精龍的領地。

    顏色與年齡The Colors of Age。妖精龍的鱗片隨其年長而改變顏色，按彩虹七色的順序作變換。所有妖精龍都具有天生的施法能力，而其成長過程中還可以逐漸獲得新的法術。

挑戰等級：紅、橙、黃色妖精龍爲1（200 XP），綠、藍、靛、紫色妖精龍爲2（450 XP）

巢穴動作Lair Actions

在怪物圖鑑中，妖精龍在巢穴裏不會進行巢穴動作。但取決於您的意願，一隻綠色或更老的 妖精龍可以在先攻輪到20時（出現等值時視爲後手），該可執行一個巢穴動作併產生下列效應其一：

混亂靈光Chaotic Aura。妖精龍在它身邊創造出誤導性的氣與魔法流。直到下輪的先攻20值錢，每當一次遠程攻擊對妖精龍失手時，重骰一次攻擊並指定妖精龍30尺內隨機一個沒有對這次攻擊產生全身掩護的生物。

纏繞植物Grasping Plants。妖精龍讓它身邊的根鬚與藤蔓暫時性生長，直到下一回合先攻20值前，小龍20尺內的地面會成爲困難地形。

區域效應

一個居住着一條 妖精龍的區域會被它的存在所轉化，產生以下一種或多種效應：

義務供奉Compulsory Offering。在一個生物第一次進入到妖精龍巢穴的一里以內時，該生物必須通過DC15感知豁免，否則就會感覺到一股強大的義務感促使他在旁邊偏僻處留下至少價值5gp的財物供奉。妖精龍會立刻意識到這份禮物的位置。一個生物只能被這種強迫影響一次。

可塑時間Malleable Time。在妖精龍巢穴一里以內的時間是不固定的，這裏的時間會比正常時間慢一半到快兩倍不等。

惡作劇進行中Mischief Afoot。在小龍的巢穴5裏內居住了超過一年的聰明生物會感到一股持續的對其他人做惡作劇的需求。

若 妖精龍死亡後，這些效應會在1d10日內消散。

A faerie dragon is a cat-sized dragon with butterfly wings. It wears a sharp-toothed grin and expresses its delight by the twitching of its tail, its merriment fading only if it is attacked.

Invisible Tricksters. The only warning of a faerie dragon's presence is a stifled giggle. The dragon stays out of sight, watching invisibly as its victims contend with its pranks. When its fun is done, the dragon might reveal itself, depending on the disposition of its "prey."

Friendly and Bright. A faerie dragon has a sharp mind, a fondness for treasure and good company, and a puckish sense of humor. Travelers can play to a faerie dragon's draconic nature by offering it "treasure" in the form of sweets, baked goods, and baubles in exchange for information or safe passage through its territory.

The Colors of Age. A faerie dragon's scales change hue as it ages, moving through all the colors of the rainbow. All faerie dragons have innate spellcasting ability, gaining new spells as they mature.

Dragon ColorAge Range
Red5 years or less
Orange6–10 years
Yellow11–20 years
Green21–30 years
Blue31–40 years
Indigo41–50 years
Violet51 years or more

CR 1 (200 XP) For a red, orange, or yellow faerie dragon; 2 (450 XP) for a green, blue, indigo, or violet faerie dragon

Lair Actions

As they are presented in the Monster Manual, faerie dragons don't have access to lair actions while in their lairs. At your discretion, a @creature[Faerie Dragon (Green)||green] or @creature[Faerie Dragon (Violet)||older faerie dragon] can take one of the following lair actions on initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties):

  • Chaotic Aura. The faerie dragon creates misdirecting currents of air and magic around itself. Until initiative count 20 on the next round, whenever a ranged attack roll misses the dragon, reroll the attack against a random creature within 30 feet of the dragon that doesn't have &Reference[rule=totalcover]{total cover} against the attack.

  • Grasping Plants. The faerie dragon causes roots and vines to temporarily grow around it; until initiative count 20 on the next round, the ground within 20 feet of the dragon is difficult terrain.

Regional Effects

The region containing a faerie dragon's lair can be transformed by its presence, creating one or more of the following effects:

  • Compulsory Offering. The first time a creature comes within 1 mile of the faerie dragon's lair, the creature must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=15]] saving throw or feel an overwhelming compulsion to leave an offering worth at least 5 gp stashed in an out-of-the-way place. The dragon immediately senses the location of this gift. A creature can be affected only once by this compulsion.

  • Malleable Time. Time is fluid within 1 mile of the faerie dragon's lair, flowing somewhere between half and twice its normal speed.

  • Mischief Afoot. Sapient creatures that spend a year within 5 miles of the faerie dragon's lair feel the persistent urge to play pranks on others.

If the faerie dragon dies, these effects fade over the course of [[/r 1d10]] days.

炫目的彩光從你指間散射而出。擲一次 6d10；其結果爲受該法術影響生物的生命值總數。在以你爲源點的 15 尺錐狀區域內的生物以剩餘生命值由小至大的順序受法術影響（生效時忽略昏迷生物和不能視物的生物）。
計算受法術影響生物時，從剩餘生命值最低的生物開始逐個計算。每個受術生物均陷入目盲，直至你的下一回合結束。法術擲骰的生命值總數減去一個受術生物的生命值後，餘數再用以計算生命值稍高者是否受法術影響。生物剩餘生命值，必須小於等於該餘數法術才能成功影響該生物。
升環施法效應：使用二環或更高法術位施展該法術時，你使用的法術位每比一環高一環，法術的擲骰時就增加 2d10。

A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand. Roll [[/r 6d10]]; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can effect. Creatures in a 15-foot cone originating from you are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring &Reference[condition=unconscious] creatures and creatures that can't see).

Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this spell is &Reference[condition=blinded] until the end of your next turn. Subtract each creature's hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature's hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional [[/r 2d10]] for each slot level above 1st.

materials.value: 一撮粉末或沙子，其顏色必須包含紅、黃、藍三色a pinch of powder or sand that is colored red, yellow, and blue

你在施法距離內創造四個火把大小的光源。法術持續時間內，光源能夠以火把，燈籠或光球的形態顯現並在空中懸浮。你也可以將四個光源合爲一箇中型類人生物的模糊光影。無論選擇哪種方式，每處光源都可以發出半徑 10 尺的微光光照。
你在自己回合可以用一個附贈動作令這些光源在施法距離內移動至多 60 尺。每個光源必需在另一個光源周邊 20 尺內，而離開施法距離的光源會隨即熄滅

You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration. You can also combine the four lights into one glowing vaguely humanoid form of Medium size. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a new spot within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light winks out if it exceeds the spell's range.

materials.value: 一點磷或光榆木，或者一隻螢火蟲a bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm

description.value:
一隻漂浮的幽靈手出現在施法距離內你指定的一點。幽靈手持續存在至法術終止，或直至你以一個動作解散該法術。如果幽靈手距你的距離超過 30 尺，或者當你再次施展了該法術時，則現存的幽靈手消失不見。
你可以用動作控制幽靈手，並通過幽靈手實現一個行爲：你可以操控一個物件，或者打開一扇未上鎖的門或容器，或者將一件物品放入容器或從容器中取出，或者將小瓶中的內容物傾倒出來。你每次你使用幽靈手時可以令其移動至多 30 尺。
該幽靈手不能攻擊，也不能激活魔法物品或承載超過 10 磅重的物質。

A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

You can use your action to control the hand. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. You can move the hand up to 30 feet each time you use it.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

你創造一個影像，其形象來自一個大小不超過邊長 20 尺立方體的物件，生物或其他的可視現象。影像出現在施法距離內你能看見的一處位置並在法術持續時間內維持存在。它看起來完全是真實的，並且還具有相應的聲音、氣味和溫度。你不能創造出足以造成傷害的酷熱或嚴寒，也不能創造出音量大到足以造成雷鳴傷害或者震聾生物的聲響，同樣不能創造出會使生物噁心的氣味（近似穴蜥人的惡臭那種）。
在該幻象施法距離內時，你可以用你的動作將影像移動到施法距離內的另一個位置。影像改變位置時，你可以改變影像的外表來使它移動得更自然。例如，如果你創造了一個生物的影像並移動它，則你可以改變影像，使它看起來就像是在走路。或者你也可以讓影像在不同的時間發出不同的聲音，甚至可以讓它參與一場對話。
由於影像無法被碰到，任何與該影像進行的物理互動都會暴露其幻象的本質。一個生物用其動作調查影像時，它可以進行一次對抗你的法術豁免 DC 的智力（調查）檢定，以判定是否看穿幻象。辨出幻象的生物可以看破該影像，而影像的其他感官效應在該生物看來會變得微弱而模糊。
升環施法效應：使用六環或更高法術位施展該法術時，法術會持續至解除且不需要你保持專注。

You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems completely real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted. You can't create sufficient heat or cold to cause damage, a sound loud enough to deal thunder damage or deafen a creature, or a smell that might sicken a creature (like a @creature[troglodyte||troglodyte's] stench).

As long as you are within range of the illusion, you can use your action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Similarly, you can cause the illusion to make different sounds at different times, even making it carry on a conversation, for example.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (&Reference[skill=Investigation]) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring your @status[concentration].

materials.value: 一小塊羊毛a bit of fleece

description.value:
在施法距離內創造一段聲響或一個物件的影像，並使之維持至法術持續時間結束。你也可以用一個動作解除幻象，或者再次施展該法術來終止幻象。
如果你創造一段聲響，其音量可以是低聲耳語也可以是高聲尖叫。它可以是你或其他任何人的嗓音，或者是一頭獅子的咆哮、一段鼓聲以及任何你指定的其它聲響。聲響在持續時間內不會減弱，或者你也可以於法術終止前在不同的時間段創造幾段分散的聲響。
如果你創造一個物件的影像（比如一把椅子、泥濘的腳印、一個小箱子等），則該物件大小不得大於一個邊長 5 尺的立方體。該影像不具有聲音、光亮、味道或任何其他的感官效應。由於影像可以被任何物件所穿透，因此與之進行物理互動時都會揭露其幻象的本質。
生物用其動作調查該聲響或影像時，必須進行一次對抗該法術豁免 DC 的智力（調查）檢定，檢定成功則判斷出眼前即是幻象。幻象在看穿它的生物面前會顯得模糊不清。

You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again.

If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.

If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it.

If a creature uses its action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (&Reference[skill=Investigation]) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

description.value:
三個與你自身一模一樣的幻象分身出現在你所處的空間中。直至法術終止前，所有分身都會隨你移動、模仿你的動作、並不斷地變換位置，使人無法追蹤判斷哪個是你的分身哪個是你的真身。分身存在期間，你可以用動作來消解這些幻象分身。
在法術持續時間內，每當有生物以你爲目標發動攻擊時，其攻擊都有概率改爲以三個分身之一爲目標，你擲一枚d20：
如果你有三個分身，則你必須擲出 6 或更高數值才能使此次攻擊的目標改爲分身；
如果你有兩個分身，則你必須擲出 8 或更高數值；
如果你有一個分身，則你必須擲出 11 或更高數值。
每個分身的AC都等於10+你的敏捷調整值。如果一次攻擊命中了分身，該分身將立即被摧毀。分身只會被命中它的攻擊摧毀，其無視所有其他的傷害和效應。三個分身全部被毀後此法術提前終止。
如果一個生物無法視物、它可以依靠視覺之外的其它感官視物（例如盲視），又或者它可以看破幻象（例如真實視覺），則該生物將不受此法術影響。

Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real. You can use your action to dismiss the illusory duplicates.

Each time a creature targets you with an attack during the spell's duration, roll a [[/r d20]] to determine whether the attack instead targets one of your duplicates.

If you have three duplicates, you must roll a 6 or higher to change the attack's target to a duplicate. With two duplicates, you must roll an 8 or higher. With one duplicate, you must roll an 11 or higher.

A duplicate's AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier. If an attack hits a duplicate, the duplicate is destroyed. A duplicate can be destroyed only by an attack that hits it. It ignores all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.

A creature is unaffected by this spell if it can't see, if it relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if it can perceive illusions as false, as with &Reference[rule=truesight].

你以魔法影響施法距離內一個你能看見的生物，並對其施以某種行動暗示（至多以一兩句話的形式）。由你指定的受術目標必須能聽到並理解你的話語。而不能被魅惑的生物也將免疫此效應。你的暗示言辭必須能讓其行爲聽起來合乎情理。要求生物刺傷它自己，自己撞向矛尖上，讓它自我犧牲，或是讓它做任何明顯有害的行爲都會直接取消該法術所產生的效應。
該目標必須進行一次感知豁免，豁免失敗者將盡其所能地從事你所描述的行爲。你所暗示的行爲可能會在法術持續時間內始終一直進行。而如果你所暗示的活動可以用更短的時間完成，則此法術會在目標完成了你的要求後隨即終止。
你也可以描述一種在持續時間內發生的特定狀況，作爲觸發特殊行爲的條件。例如，你可以暗示一名騎士將她所有的錢交給她遇到的第一名乞丐。如果在法術終止前條件始終沒有滿足，則指定的行爲不會被執行。
若你或你同伴中任何人傷害了受術者，則該法術隨即終止。

You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be &Reference[condition=charmed] are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act ends the spell.

The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it pursues the course of action you described to the best of its ability. The suggested course of action can continue for the entire duration. If the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends when the subject finishes what it was asked to do.

You can also specify conditions that will trigger a special activity during the duration. For example, you might suggest that a knight give her warhorse to the first beggar she meets. If the condition isn't met before the spell expires, the activity isn't performed.

If you or any of your companions damage the target, the spell ends.

可塑時間Malleable Time。在妖精龍巢穴一里以內的時間是不固定的，這裏的時間會比正常時間慢一半到快兩倍不等。

惡作劇進行中Mischief Afoot。在小龍的巢穴5裏內居住了超過一年的聰明生物會感到一股持續的對其他人做惡作劇的需求。

若 妖精龍死亡後，這些效應會在1d10日內消散。

The region containing a faerie dragon's lair can be transformed by its presence, creating one or more of the following effects:

  • Compulsory Offering. The first time a creature comes within 1 mile of the faerie dragon's lair, the creature must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=15]] saving throw or feel an overwhelming compulsion to leave an offering worth at least 5 gp stashed in an out-of-the-way place. The dragon immediately senses the location of this gift. A creature can be affected only once by this compulsion.

  • Malleable Time. Time is fluid within 1 mile of the faerie dragon's lair, flowing somewhere between half and twice its normal speed.

  • Mischief Afoot. Sapient creatures that spend a year within 5 miles of the faerie dragon's lair feel the persistent urge to play pranks on others.

If the faerie dragon dies, these effects fade over the course of [[/r 1d10]] days.

items.name: 顏色與年齡The Colors of Age

description.value:
妖精龍的鱗片隨其年長而改變顏色，按彩虹七色的順序作變換。所有妖精龍都具有天生的施法能力，而其成長過程中還可以逐漸獲得新的法術。

龍鱗色調

年齡範圍

紅red

5歲以下

橙orange

6~10歲

黃yellow

11~20歲

綠green

21~30歲

藍blue

31~40歲

靛ingigo

41~50歲

紫violet

51歲及以上

A faerie dragon's scales change hue as it ages, moving through all the colors of the rainbow. All faerie dragons have innate spellcasting ability, gaining new spells as they mature.

Red—5 years or less

Orange—6–10 years

Yellow—11–20 years

Green—21–30 years

Blue—31–40 years

Indigo—41–50 years

Violet—51 years or more

A green or older faerie dragon's CR increases to 2.

透過心靈感應能力，妖精龍可以用魔法與其周邊60尺內的其它妖精龍進行溝通。

Using telepathy, the dragon can magically communicate with any other faerie dragon within 60 feet of it.

妖精龍進行抵抗法術和其它魔法效應的豁免檢定時具有優勢。

The faerie dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

戰武器攻擊：+7命中，觸及5尺，單一生物。命中：1點穿刺傷害。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+7]]{+7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

妖精龍對5尺內的一個生物噴出一團歡愉氣體。目標必須進行一次DC 11的感知豁免，豁免失敗則目標在1分鐘內無法進行任何反應，且必須在每輪開始時擲一次d6以決定自身的行爲：
  1~4。目標不進行動作或附贈動作，並用其所有移動力向某個隨機方向移動。
  5~6。目標不移動，它唯一能做的便是在其自己回合進行一次DC 11的感知豁免，豁免成功則終止吐息在其身上的效應。

 

The dragon exhales a puff of euphoria gas at one creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=11]] saving throw, or for 1 minute, the target can't take reactions and must roll a [[/r d6]] at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior during the turn:

1–4. The target takes no action or bonus action and uses all of its movement to move in a random direction.

5–6. The target doesn't move, and the only thing it can do on its turn is make a [[/save ability=wis dc=11]] saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

作爲一個附贈動作，妖精龍可以在專注結束前始終隱匿身形（等同專注於法術）。妖精龍着裝或攜帶的任何裝備都會隨之隱形。

As a bonus action, the dragon can magically turn &Reference[condition=invisible] until its @status[concentration] ends (as if @status[concentration||concentrating] on a spell). Any equipment the dragon wears or carries is &Reference[condition=invisible] with it.

妖精龍在它身邊創造出誤導性的氣與魔法流。直到下輪的先攻20值錢，每當一次遠程攻擊對妖精龍失手時，重骰一次攻擊並指定妖精龍30尺內隨機一個沒有對這次攻擊產生全身掩護的生物。

The faerie dragon creates misdirecting currents of air and magic around itself. Until initiative count 20 on the next round, whenever a ranged attack roll misses the dragon, reroll the attack against a random creature within 30 feet of the dragon that doesn't have &Reference[rule=totalcover]{total cover} against the attack.

妖精龍讓它身邊的根鬚與藤蔓暫時性生長，直到下一回合先攻20值前，小龍20尺內的地面會成爲困難地形。

The faerie dragon causes roots and vines to temporarily grow around it; until initiative count 20 on the next round, the ground within 20 feet of the dragon is difficult terrain.
